newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis offers mostly steady.

text.p: Soymeal basis offers were mostly steady Monday, but the cash market remained underpinned by a lack of soymeal for prompt delivery, dealers said.
"There's very little you can do in the spot market," said one southeastern soymeal broker."Right now, there's nothing out there."
Brokers looked for available supplies to increase in one or two weeks as more beans move into the hands of crushers.
Midwestern farmers made good harvest progress this weekend, and with favorable weather, some should finish by week's end.
"They're trying to wrap it up," one river dealer said. "Nobody wants to have Thanksgiving dinner in their combine."
Exporters were said to be consuming most of the spot soymeal as some domestic users found current meal prices too high, dealers said.
